brief: A utensil holder with two bins that is waterproof and dishwasher safe.

requirements.evidence: Two full-depth bins installed: bin:0,0,0~hex-bin-full and bin:1,0,0~hex-bin-full in adjacent cells piece:0,0,0 and piece:1,0,0, dressed with utensil props (spoon, knife) resting in bins.

Configurator checks fit/collisions only; cannot verify sealing, layer-line porosity, or material water resistance. All parts are 3D-printed plastic as chosen by user; waterproofing not verified. Shape provides open storage only.

Configurator knows nothing about heat resistance, food safety, or dishwasher tolerance. Parts are 3D-printed in user-chosen material; heat/warping, detergent resistance, and food-contact safety not verified.

finish.summary: Built a two-cell base with two full-depth bins as utensil holders. Utensils staged in bins. Waterproof and dishwasher-safe claims cannot be met by the configurator - it only checks geometry, not materials, sealing, heat or food safety - so those requirements are unmet.

lines.label: M6 x 25 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.
